## What changed / 变更内容

<!--
English: Describe what changed and why.
中文：说明改了什么，以及为什么要改。
-->

## Stack / 堆叠关系

<!--
English: State the base branch and any PRs that must merge first. Write "Independent" when this PR has no dependency.
中文：说明基础分支和必须先合并的 PR；没有依赖时填写“独立”。
-->

## Validation / 验证结果

- [ ] `uv run python scripts/check.py`
- [ ] English: New or changed behavior has automated coverage
- [ ] 中文：新增或变更的行为已有自动化测试覆盖
- [ ] English: No secrets, customer data, generated output, or model weights are included
- [ ] 中文：未提交密钥、客户数据、生成产物或模型权重

## Known validation limit / 已知验证限制

<!--
English: List checks that could not be run and explain why. Write "None" when all relevant checks ran.
中文：列出无法执行的检查及原因；全部完成时填写“无”。
-->
